Opus 5.5 medium players, an Opus 5.5 high commander, hands Jev jev-latest (1.13.0 per the impedance review), hands effort normal, realtime.

result.minute: 22:45 (the commander surrendered; units self-destructed 22:54, record ends 22:59)

summary: Four seats of ours took 50 extractors by 8:00 and led in army seen (about 3 to 1 at 10:14), but the side's metal income stayed at 110-135 from 8:00 to the end, and no seat began tier 2 until 12:46. thebluegecko held the middle with armed extractors and heavy laser towers from about 8:44. Our 3x lead went into his posts piecemeal and traded about even (9:00-12:00: 10.3k lost against 8.3k of his seen dead). His tier 2 showed at 12:39-12:51: an advanced constructor, mohos and a Tzar. From then the trade ran 2.4 to 1 and then 3.5 to 1 against our tier-1 bodies, which grew artillery-heavy. Bombers at 19:10 and about 37 Wasps at 21:54 met a side with seven anti-air turrets built by 17:00 and wiped t3, t5 and t2's advanced plants. Asked afterwards, he said the loss was the economy, not the units: "I have more money, so I have more units".

root.what: The side's extractors stopped at about 48-50: his armed extractors and towers held the middle, and the Grunt body held t3's lane. The side had a 1.7k bank and spare energy, and nobody teched. The commander expected his tier 2 at about 10:00 but kept all four seats on tier-1 units, extra tier-1 plants and converters. At 10:14 it spent the lead into his posts. The one advanced plant began 12:46 and the first moho stood 20:38. That eco was the cause is thebluegecko's verdict (a person); the minute is the reader's.
root.evidence: team_read: 8:00 side extractors 50, then 47-50 to 18:00. Summed records: side metal income 116 at 8:00, 113 at 12:00, 115 at 19:00; side bank 1,680 at 8:00. Commander 8:44: 'he can be in tier 2 from about 10:00'. First coravp created 12:46 (seat 0).

our_mistakes.what: No tier 2 when the spots ran out. The side's bank and energy went into extra tier-1 plants, nanos and about 20 converters. The commander kept every seat on tier 1 until 13:14, then let one seat start, with no feeding ('t3, t4, t5 keep all metal on units'). A stronger side has one seat sprint at about 8:00 while the others feed it, with mohos by about 11:00.
our_mistakes.evidence: Factories: t4 armlab 5:25 and a second armvp 7:48, t2 corlab 9:17. Converters finished: t2 5 (from 11:30), t3 9, t4 3, t5 3. Commander 13:14: 'Assumed T2 for one seat is worth it since banks are zero and spots are capped at 48'

our_mistakes.what: The one sprint was slow and starved. One advanced plant took 4:01 on t2's income of about 32 with the store at 0. Then the first moho, begun 18:01, stood at 20:38, through an energy stall. The first advanced constructor came 17:05, the first moho 20:38.
our_mistakes.evidence: coravp created 12:46, finished 16:47. coracv finished 17:05. cormoho created 18:01, finished 20:38. t2 18:09: 'energy store 1157 falling 593/s (Banisher + 2 mohos + 5 advanced solars at once)'

our_mistakes.what: The lead was sent into turret posts piecemeal instead of as one body, or around the strongest position. The posts and his Lazarus and Graverobbers turned our dead into his reclaim.
our_mistakes.evidence: hands_window seat 2, 11:08: 'group_E_t4: 22 at (1787, 4745), task engage' while party_91 '2 armjanus, 10 armrectr, 6 armstump' stood at (2712,2580). Commander 11:44: 'piecemeal pushes into turret posts'

our_mistakes.what: Production was turned to tier-1 artillery against Tzars: Wolverines and Shellshockers with no front line. That is thebluegecko's 'too many T1 arty units'.
our_mistakes.evidence: Commander 14:44: 'Production toward Wolverines/Shellshockers'. t3 18:38: 'east body is now 25 Wolverines + 5 Shellshockers, no screen'. thebluegecko 21:09: 'I think that was too many T1 arty units'

our_mistakes.what: Anti-air came late even though the commander asked for it from the first minute. t4 built none before 19:44, and the side had seven anti-air turrets by 17:00 when bombers and then Wasps came. u6bkep said the same in human-10 on this map: pre-emptively go air.
our_mistakes.evidence: Commander note 0:06: 'early cheap AA from 6:00 against gecko's known gunships'. AA finished by seat before 17:00: t2 6:44; t3 11:07, 16:40, 16:54; t5 7:17, 11:44, 11:48; t4 none (first 19:44). Commander 19:14: 'AA was asked for since 0:06 and barely built'

our_mistakes.what: His base was never scouted. H1-H2 was asked for five times, the Rover was merged into a group, and his advanced plant was never seen.
our_mistakes.evidence: minutes.py: 'his first factory seen: never'. Commander 19:14: 'the big miss along with never scouting H1-H2'. Impedance review 12:32 t5: the Rover joined group_Q_t5 and 'died at G4 at 16:37'

our_mistakes.what: The side believed it was ahead on economy because it read the report's floors of his extractors as values. That belief held back the tech decision.
our_mistakes.evidence: Commander 8:44: '48 extractors to his 20'. 16:14: 'We still out-earn him (49 extractors to his 23 known)'. The engine refused our extractors at H4, F4, G4 where his unseen extractors stood (impedance review B3)

our_mistakes.what: Two advanced vehicle plants went up on one #avp1 id. A remove sent with a stop in the same turn was accepted but never carried out, and the other builders repaired the second frame to 100%. About 2,600 of t2's tier-2 metal went into it.
our_mistakes.evidence: hands_window seat 0 12:41: 'constructor_26284: build a coravp at avp_yard (E7) (#avp1) [list] | constructor_6718: build a coravp at avp_yard (E7) (#avp1) [list]'. coravp finished 16:47 and 16:54

their_play: thebluegecko (Cortex, east, his base never seen, likely G1-H2) opened Grunts with Graverobbers. His first heavy laser tower was seen at E3 at 5:40, and by 8:44 he had armed extractors and towers at D3/D4, E4 and G4, so he held the middle. His extractors also stood unseen at H4, F4 and G4, where the engine refused ours. He had an advanced constructor, mohos at G3/H4 and a Tzar out by 12:39-12:51. Then came: up to six Tzars and a Scorpion at G4; eight Graverobbers raising wrecks at F4; a heavy transport (15:47); hovers raiding our south-shore tidals (17:48-19:07); ten Whirlwind bombers (19:10); about 37 Wasps (21:54). u6bkep (Armada, west) massed ten Pawns at B3 (5:19) and killed t2's Incisor raid with Blitzes at C2 (6:17-7:14). He then held C3 with a heavy laser tower, Beamers, Stouts, Janus and ten Lazarus. Their verdict: 'too many T1 arty units', then 'it isnt just unit choice, it is eco ... I have more money, so I have more units'.

bears_on.note: This game is one of the lesson's three sources. Here 'eco' did not mean spots: our side held 48-50 extractors of 88 from 8:00. It meant income growth through tier 2 and reclaim, which we never made (side income 110-135 for 14 minutes).
A source game. From 14:44 the bodies were mostly Wolverines and Shellshockers with no screen, against Tzars.
There was a bank and spare energy at 7-9 min, and no tier 2 until 12:46 on one seat.
Tier-1 mass against Tzars under towers lost 14.7k to 6.2k (12:00-15:00) and 22.4k to 6.5k (15:00-18:00).
Commander 11:44: each seat's body hit his posts alone and piecemeal. t4 11:16: 'front at C3, tail 4,000 back'.
The lead was used (10:14, 'into his half NOW') but went into turret posts and traded even. Using a lead is not enough when it walks into posts.
Same map and same people as human-10, and the same shape again: towers in the middle attacked head-on, then bombers and gunships against little anti-air.
His D4, E4, G4 and C3 posts were stronger per metal than the bodies sent at them.
Said in this game (0:46, 1:14). Wreck fields of 11.8k-13.7k lay in the middle at 13:07-13:45 (wake lines), while his Graverobbers and u6bkep's ten Lazarus worked them. Our reclaim was mostly t4's.
The wrecks of our piecemeal pushes lay on his side of the middle. He resurrected them (t3 16:48: 'three Tzars at F4/G4 with 8 cornecro raising wrecks').
Said at 0:12. t2, t3 and t4 built tidals early (t2 and t3 seven each, t4 four); t5 built none. Hovers raided the south-shore tidals at 19:07.
We held about half the map's spots at tier 1 and still lost on income. The corners were never raided (his base never seen).
About 20 converters on full energy stores from 11:30 stood in for mohos.

lens.caveats: No truth file: his economy, his tier-2 start and his army are unmeasured, so 'he had more money' rests on thebluegecko's word. minutes.py, analyze_match, floor, raid_ledger and wake_read read record-0 (t2) only. Their 'army ours' is t2's alone, and its fall to 140 at 13:00 is group_A_t2 handed to t4, not a loss. Side figures come from team_read and the reader's sums over the four records. 'His seen dead' counts unique enemy_destroyed ids. pro_baseline was not run (Gecko Isle has no cards). There is no ledger row. The match directory holds impedance-review.md and unfinished-review.md (model reviews, used here) but no review.md. chat.jsonl has no computer_whisperer line; the user's post-game remark comes from commit 4ed68d8.

open_questions: When did thebluegecko place his advanced plant, and what was the people's income at 8-13 min? The engine replay through run/replay_match.py would answer it, as it did for Center Command.
How much of the 12-14k middle wreck field went to his Graverobbers and Lazarus against our reclaim?
Could the side have funded a sprint at 8:00? The side bank was 1,680 and t2's income 31. Feeding by transfer from three seats was never tried.
Did the report's floors of his extractors ('48 to his 23') delay the tech decision, or did the commander's 'spend the lead first' doctrine?
